log.title: Event log
log.help: The last events the app recorded, newest first. Each has a time, what happened, the kind of task and a reason code. It never holds track names, file paths or error text, and it stays on this computer.
log.lost_one: {{count, number}} event couldn't be saved to the log file this time. It is still listed here until the app closes.
log.lost_other: {{count, number}} events couldn't be saved to the log file this time. They are still listed here until the app closes.
log.error: Couldn't read the event log. Try again.

reason.jobFailed: The task stopped with an error
reason.noHandler: This version can't run that task
reason.exportOlderThanLastSend: The export is older than the last send

report.title: Report
report.help: A short text for a bug report. It holds the app version, your Windows version, counts, which tasks failed and why, and the recent events above. It never holds track names, file paths, keys or anything you typed. Nothing is sent: you choose where to paste it.
report.previewLabel: The report, exactly as it will be saved
report.saved: Saved. The report is a text file in the app's data folder. The app keeps the last 5.
report.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
report.createError: Couldn't create the report. Try again.
report.saveError: Couldn't save the report. Try again.
